In the middle of this split screen is a red circle with the word "LIVE" on top of a black line and a Canadian flag, with the word "ON" underneath the line. The camera pans through the snowy forest setting, covered in trees and fallen logs, with the sun shining through the trees. The person follows the trail through a wooden path. There are various trees with snow on the branches. At one point, the person passes by a sign with the trail information and rules. The video then ends as the person hikes on.
